rule: Clusters group questions that concern the same political conflict family but are not necessarily semantically identical. Cluster membership never merges questions or party positions; it is used to preserve nuance and reduce accidental overweighting in sampling.

clusters.title: Kärnkraftens roll och utbyggnad
clusters.note: Long-term role, state financing and permitted siting are separate policy choices and must not be collapsed into one answer.

clusters.title: Skolsystemets styrning, val och utförare
clusters.note: State responsibility, school choice, independent schools and profit extraction are related but distinct institutional choices.

clusters.title: Arbetstidens längd
clusters.note: A general reduction in working time is not identical to a specified 35-hour legal work week.

clusters.title: Tandvårdens finansiering och avgifter
clusters.note: General financing principles and the age limit for free dental care are related but answerable separately.

clusters.title: Nato, utländsk militär närvaro och kärnvapen
clusters.note: Membership, permanent foreign bases and nuclear weapons on Swedish territory are separate choices.

clusters.title: Brottsbekämpningens preventiva och processuella verktyg
clusters.note: The measures share a civil-liberties versus crime-control dimension but have different legal effects.

clusters.title: Privata aktörers roll i sjukvården
clusters.note: Whether private providers may deliver tax-funded care is distinct from whether private insurance may confer priority in publicly funded care.

clusters.title: Arbetskraftsinvandringens omfattning och modell
clusters.note: A needs test and a generally more open labor-migration regime are related but not equivalent positions.
